name: Blackfoot River
blurb: A River Runs Through It water. Clear pools, ledge rock, and a famous recreation corridor.

sections.notes: Includes Bear Creek Rapids upstream of the Clearwater confluence. Roundup has a raft slide; check launch suitability and current conditions.

distanceEvidence.note: Approximate river mileage from the difference between nearby FWP 0.1-mile markers on the same river. Facility locations and mapped channels introduce uncertainty; this is not a surveyed paddling route or a speed calibration.

sections.notes: Includes Thibodeau Rapids upstream of Johnsrud. FWP maps Class II and III rapids here; low water exposes rock gardens.

notices.title: Thibodeau Rapids are on this section
notices.text: FWP maps Class II and III rapids near river mile 17, between Roundup and Johnsrud. Review the agency guide and current conditions before choosing this float.
notices.sourceName: Montana FWP Blackfoot Floaters Guide, map 6

sections.notes: Lower Blackfoot to the Weigh Station access near Bonner. Thibodeau Rapids are upstream of this put-in, not on this section.
